label: LTX-2.5 distilled (text / keyframes to video + audio)

capabilities._note: duration: predict. LTX 2.4+ has a duration head: `dur: model` shots get ComfyUI's ModelPatchLoader (the preset's duration_head file, from models/model_patches) + LTXVDurationPredictor, whose num_frames (8k+1) drives every length input of the graph. The build writes an estimate (the dialogue's `dur: auto` length, else the preset's default_seconds); without the weights installed the take renders that estimate and says so.

template._note: LTX-2 renders 8k+1 frames (9, 17, ..., 97, ...). This workflow is two-stage: a base pass at half size, then the x2 latent upsampler and a refine pass, so the output must be a multiple of 64 (the base latent needs 32). Sizes that aren't legal are snapped down, then shrunk under 1 MP / 1536 on the long side. The frame rate is the series config's. LTX-2 handles about 20 s per shot.

recipe._note: No identity references: subjects are written in words from the series config's `design`, the location from its `description`. Optional shot keyframes: shot:<id>:first conditions frame 0 (LTXVImgToVideoInplace), shot:<id>:last the final frame (LTXVAddGuide). A shot with neither renders text-to-video. LTX-2 makes the soundtrack with the picture and takes no voice sample or recording, so clone / dub / dub_keep_foley shots render with generate and say so.

policy_fallback.why: LTX-2 generates sound with the picture and takes no voice sample or recording

size_hints.keyframe: the render size (any size works: it is resized to the frame)

binding._note: The workflow is ComfyUI's LTX-2.5 image-to-video template (a subgraph, flattened by h3jobs.ui_to_api). Every value is patched straight into a widget: there is no loader node, so a text-only shot needs no custom node beyond H3SaveShot, which takes the place of CreateVideo/SaveVideo. The prompt enhancer (TextGenerateLTX2Prompt) is never used: the prompt goes into the positive CLIPTextEncode, and prune drops the enhancer with everything else the saver doesn't need.

duration_predictor._note: For `dur: model` (capabilities.duration): h3jobs.graph_for adds ModelPatchLoader + LTXVDurationPredictor, reading the model and positive conditioning that feed these inputs, and links its num_frames into every `length` widget above.

models._note: The family each model param must be (targets/modelid.py): names first, then the file's header (LTX files carry model_version; 2.5's transformer also has keyframes_abs_pos_embedding and no video feed-forward biases). The 2.3 and 2.5 upscalers share every tensor and have no metadata: only the name tells them apart. duration_head is a preset value, not a binding widget: ModelPatchLoader reads it from models/model_patches. Tiers (docs/API.md): the duration head is optional (without it `dur: model` renders the estimate); everything else is required. No base: the preset is already the distilled model with the workflow's fixed 8 + 3 step schedule, and a dev model would need another schedule, so a substitute must say `distilled` like the wanted file (`keep`).

nodes._note: Node classes beyond the workflow's own: the keyframe conditioning patch_graph adds (ComfyUI core), and the duration predictor `dur: model` adds (optional: without it the build's estimate is rendered).

presets._note: LTX-2.5 22B distilled (int8): a fixed 8-step base schedule plus a 3-step refine (the workflow's ManualSigmas; `steps` is recorded, not patched). The final is the workflow's 768x512 unless the series config sets a size; the proxy is 448x256. Both use the same model: the distilled model is already fast. The negative prompt is the IC-LoRA model card's suggestion plus the artefacts a review cut can't use; the template's own ('pc game, ..., cartoon, childish') would fight a cartoon series' look. For `dur: model` (capabilities): duration_head is the LTX-2.5 duration head in models/model_patches (not in the shotlist's defaults; checked at queue time), default_seconds the estimate of a silent shot, min_seconds/max_seconds the predictor's range when the script gives none.

final.negative: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted, flickering, morphing, extra limbs, watermark, subtitles

proxy.negative: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted, flickering, morphing, extra limbs, watermark, subtitles

downloads._note: Where to get each file this target names (docs/API.md 'Downloads'). A url is only given when a trustworthy record has it: a ComfyUI template's or saved workflow's properties.models entry, or ComfyUI-Manager's model list; `source` says which. Otherwise url is null and source says what to search for. Never a guessed URL.
